packageRules.description: MCP SDK: its own PR, never grouped or merged by itself. A bump moves the protocol surface and the SDK's security defaults, so it goes in only after the MCP interop tests and the hardware checklist have run again.
web/lint-ts pins TypeScript 6 beside the project's TypeScript 7, because typescript-eslint does not support 7 yet (typescript-eslint#10940). It stays until that issue closes (#128).

BombVault's own image stays on :latest in deploy/docker-compose.generic.yml. People copy that file to run BombVault, and a digest there would freeze every copy on one build and drift from the Unraid template (#168).
